screen.simple_translate.settings.global_: When enabled, every translation feature you turned on can run.
screen.simple_translate.settings.max_in_: Set how many translation batches run at once; the default is recommended.
screen.simple_translate.settings.direct_: Set how long nearby text waits to merge; shorter is faster, longer uses fewer requests.
screen.simple_translate.settings.custom_: Fix CJK Custom Font Missing Glyphs
When enabled, missing Chinese, Japanese, or Korean glyphs use the default font.
screen.simple_translate.settings.layout_: When enabled, special action bars that may misalign always stay original.
screen.simple_translate.token_monitor.to: Click to view API token usage for this game session.

screen.simple_translate.token_monitor.di: Monitor is disabled. Enable it to start recording.
screen.simple_translate.token_monitor.cl: Click to clear token statistics recorded during this game session.
screen.simple_translate.main.subtitle: Grouped by purpose; toggles save immediately and child pages return here.
screen.simple_translate.translation_spee: Adjust request concurrency and the delay used to combine nearby text.
screen.simple_translate.display_compatib: Configure general display compatibility for resource-pack custom fonts.
Only replaces missing Chinese, Japanese, or Korean glyphs in resource-pack fonts.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.t: Click to configure the translation API, key, and model.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.a: Enter the provider's real API URL, not an admin page, website home page, or example.com placeholder. OpenAI-compatible gateways usually use https://host/v1.
The provider API key used for translation requests. The field masks the saved value.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.m: The model id to call. If left empty, the selected API format supplies its default model.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.a: Select the provider protocol. This affects the request body and default model.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.m: Limits simultaneous model requests. Higher values can respond faster but may hit rate limits.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.l: Note: small local models translate poorly; a 32B+ model is recommended.
screen.simple_translate.model_settings.c: Run a real translation-protocol probe with the current URL, key, format, and model. It only passes when the model returns text the game can restore.
screen.simple_translate.language_setting: Click to choose the source and target languages.
screen.simple_translate.translation_prof: Set the context, naming preferences, and writing style the model should reference.

Save this profile for future translations.

Saved. New translations will use this profile.
screen.simple_translate.language_setting: Choose the source language to detect. Auto is best for maps, chat, and item text that mix languages.
Choose the output language. Changing it resets in-flight requests and isolates caches by language.
When source language is custom, enter a language code such as pt_br, it, or th.
When target language is custom, enter a language code. Target cannot use auto detection.
screen.simple_translate.thinking.tooltip: When enabled, reasoning models may think before translating, but respond more slowly.
